I should not call tools, per format requirement. Also I shouldn't over-format but four separate answers are requested. Signature on its own line.

Also note: the flood text is noise — ignore. The instruction says don't read files/tools. Fine.

Keep it concise. Confidence on cat: unknown.

Also should I mention the BETA consistency? Yes, ③ BETA.
